![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13933898/assets/0b0074bb582011695cec9807beab1623c6aab894e0c6abeb1bf3068be6ed3543.png)

Find ${lim}_{x\to \,3}\frac{\sqrt{25-f(x)}}{2}$ for the function $f(x)$ plotted above.
question.worked_solution:
From the graph, we get that ${lim}_{x\to \,3}f(x)=9.$ 

Applying the root rule, we get
 

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \,3}\frac{\sqrt{25-f(x)}}{2} & =\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{{lim}_{x\to \,3}(25-f(x))} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{25-9} \\  & =\frac{\sqrt{16}}{2} \\  & =\frac{4}{2} \\  & =2\,.\end{aligned}
$$
